title: Quadratic variation of elementary Itô rows
source_anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement: Quadratic variation of elementary Itô rows. Exact assumptions and formula below.
target_statement: At each level of a dyadic grid, take a row of completed Itô integrals of elementary processes on that level's grid. The sum of the squared row increments minus the row's time energy is square integrable at each level and tends to zero in mean absolute value.
